home.q: Are all Prabhav projects RERA registered?
home.a: Yes. Every launched project carries a MahaRERA number, shown on its project page.
Our projects are approved by leading banks, and our team helps with the paperwork.

home.q: Can I book a site visit on weekends?
home.a: Yes. Site visits run seven days a week, with free pick-up from the station.

contact.q: How soon will you call back?
contact.a: Within one working day, usually the same day.

contact.q: Do you have an office I can visit?
contact.a: Yes. Our head office address and hours are listed on this page.
